sin.name: falsely-optional-field
sin.description: A field declared optional (`x?: T`, `T | null`) that is initialised where it is declared — it is never absent, and every `?.` and `??` downstream defends a case that cannot happen
sin.rule: Do not declare a field optional when it always has a value: drop the `?` and the `| null`, and the defences downstream go with them.
sin.suggestion: Declare it as its plain type — the initialiser already proves it is total.
